mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_profile_featured_content (profile_id, content_type, content_id, title_override, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{titleOverride}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
